subject: project-compass
scenario: Fold a source branch or subsystem boundary into the canonical integration line.
assertions: Source and target Compass families are compared before the fold is accepted.
Source-only, conflicting, or moved scopes remain active, retired, or explicitly unresolved rather than disappearing.
The post-fold registry, declared paths, parent outcomes, and cross-compass links validate and score against the resulting tree.
A successful fold is not counted as product progress without post-fold outcome evidence.
